title: `createImageBitmap` does not immediately convert color space, premultiply alpha, etc.
body:
### What is the issue with the HTML Standard?

Hi, while I was trying to implement the WebGPU API of [GPUQueue.copyExternalImageToTexture](https://gpuweb.github.io/gpuweb/#dom-gpuqueue-copyexternalimagetotexture) to Deno, I found the description below when I was following the [spec](https://gpuweb.github.io/gpuweb/#color-space-conversion-elision) about the treatment of Premultiplication and Color space of `ImageBitmap`.

> 3.10.2. Color Space Conversion Elision
If the source and destination of a color space/encoding conversion are the same, then conversion is not necessary. In general, if any given step of the conversion is an identity function (no-op), implementations should elide it, for performance.
 > For optimal performance, applications should set their color space and encoding options so that the number of necessary conversions is minimized throughout the process. For various image sources of [GPUCopyExternalImageSourceInfo](https://gpuweb.github.io/gpuweb/#gpucopyexternalimagesourceinfo):

> [ImageBitmap](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/imagebitmap-and-animations.html#imagebitmap):
> Premultiplication is controlled via [premultiplyAlpha](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/imagebitmap-and-animations.html#dom-imagebitmapoptions-premultiplyalpha).
> Color space is controlled via [colorSpaceConversion](https://html.spec.whatwg.org/multipage/imagebitmap-and-animations.html#dom-imagebitmapoptions-colorspaceconversion).

Yes, actually `ImageBitmap` has those option through `createImageBitmap` API, however it has no flag or slot what option specified to the `ImageBitmap` when it created.

So, I think that it needs to have internal slots to fulfill the requirements.
Furthermore, I also think that the problem cause this issue.

https://github.com/whatwg/html/issues/10142

Judging from the output image, I think Chromium implements a flag like `isPremultipliedAlpha` internally in order to output it like that.
If I have misunderstood the specifications, please let me know.
